The approve control only appears when `ExitPlanMode` is called; a turn that ends with a beautifully written summary of the plan gives the owner NOTHING TO CLICK

rules.heading: ## The rules that get broken anyway — read these before typing
rules.quote: **NEVER START A PROCESS YOU ARE NOT GOING TO MANAGE — every repo, forever.** If you start it, you own it until you have CONFIRMED it is dead: a background command, a watcher, a poll loop, a browser, a subagent.
rules.says: In every repository, a session that starts any process (background command, watcher, poll loop, browser, subagent) owns it until it has looked and confirmed it is dead, not merely until it finishes, and must not start one it will not manage.
rules.live_quote: ## 11d. Never start a process you are not going to manage. Every repo, forever. ... **IF YOU START IT, YOU OWN IT UNTIL IT IS DEAD.** A background command, a watcher, a poll loop, a browser, a subagent. Not "until it finishes" — until you have CONFIRMED it is gone.

rules.heading: Never start a process you are not going to manage
rules.quote: **The cost is not memory, it is that the session becomes unreadable from outside**
rules.says: A session must stay readable from outside so the owner can tell a working walk from a dead timer without asking; being asked about a process is itself the signal that the rule was already broken.
rules.live_quote: **it makes the session unreadable from outside.** The owner cannot tell a working walk from a dead timer, so the only way to find out is to ask, and being asked is the signal this rule was already broken.

rules.live_quote: **A waiter must be able to exit.** `pgrep -f "foo"` MATCHES ITS OWN COMMAND LINE, so `until ! pgrep -f "foo"; do sleep; done` can never terminate. ... If you must poll, poll a FILE or an exit code, never a process name.

rules.quote: Give the status, send the held call again, answer the correction, read the filed messages and the page, send the review or amend the plan or enter plan mode as the review gate's refusal says,
rules.says: After a refusal, do the remedy the refusal names (give the status, send the held call again, answer the correction, read the filed messages and page, send the review or amend the plan or enter plan mode, send a new plan through plan mode, put the plan's shape right, or carry on with the approved plan); that last refusal lifts once an agent is sent under the plan or the owner writes again.
rules.enforcer: hook-dispatch.mjs review gate, rules gate, plan-shape refusals (Doctrine §0d; §0e rule 14; LESSONS §435)
